core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hanoon corresponds to the Arabic form حنون and is glossed in this record as “Compassionate, tender, affectionate.” The record associates the form with root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hanoon corresponds to the Arabic form حنون (Arabic root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n); حَنُون (Ḥanūn)). Its core sense is compassionate, kind. Hanoon is Arabic حَنُون (Ḥanūn) 'compassionate, tender, affectionate', from the root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n). The source gloss 'contentment, satisfaction' is unsupported and belongs to a different root; it has been replaced with the lexical sense. Recorded at medium confidence because the form is primarily an adjective and its use as a given name is less frequent.

persian.name: حنون
persian.long_meaning: Hanoon (حنون) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن مهربان، دلسوز است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: हनून
